The structure of V6S8 (reduced formula V3S4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 194), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies V centers as octahedrally coordinated by six S neighbors, while S centers show two-, three-, and four-neighbor V environments. V-centered octahedra share edges with each other and corners and edges with four-vertex S polyhedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
